profile.name: Mohammed Jihad
profile.tagline: I edit videos and design motion graphics with tight pacing, rich color and clean sound.
profile.statement: Good editing is invisible. You only notice that you could not look away.
profile.bio: I'm Mohammed Jihad, a video editor and motion designer with 2 years of experience.
profile.contactText:
Need a video editor to bring your vision to life? I'd love to hear from you. Whether it's commercials, YouTube videos, reels or motion graphics, I'm ready to help create videos that make an impact.

Feel free to get in touch to discuss your project, request a quote, or simply say hello.

services.name: Commercials
services.text: Brand films, product ads and campaign cut-downs built to hold attention.

services.name: YouTube & Podcasts
services.text: Story-first pacing, multicam, captions and chapters that keep viewers watching.

services.name: Reels & Shorts
services.text: Fast vertical edits with a strong hook and animated subtitles.

services.name: Motion Graphics
services.text: Titles, logo animation, lower thirds and explainer visuals.

services.name: Weddings & Events
services.text: Highlight films and full edits that bring the day back.

services.name: Color & Sound
services.text: Grading, audio cleanup, sound design and final mix.

steps.name: Discovery
steps.text: We talk through your goal, audience, references and deadline.

steps.name: Organise
steps.text: Footage is backed up, sorted, synced and selected.

steps.name: Story cut
steps.text: The structure and rhythm come together.

steps.name: Refine
steps.text: Your notes shape the pacing, graphics and transitions.

steps.name: Color & sound
steps.text: The look is graded and the audio is cleaned, designed and mixed.

steps.name: Delivery
steps.text: You receive final files sized for every platform.
